note: Lower American River access points for the shuttle/float planner. river_mi = distance along the river from the American–Sacramento confluence (mile 0), computed by snapping each point to the OpenStreetMap river centerline. NHD+ would be more authoritative; OSM is close for this reach. Coordinates approximate — edit freely.

speed_mph.note: typical float/paddle speed at regular LAR flows

access.name: Tiscornia Beach
access.note: Sandy beach at the confluence; life jackets on site.

access.name: Discovery Park
access.note: Confluence with the Sacramento River; large park, boat ramp, restrooms.

access.name: Paradise Beach
access.note: Glen Hall Park / River Park; popular beach.

access.name: Watt Avenue Access
access.note: River access at the Watt Ave bridge.

access.name: River Bend Park
access.note: Formerly Goethe Park; beaches and parking (Rancho Cordova).

access.name: Ancil Hoffman Park
access.note: Large Carmichael park on a river bend.

access.name: El Manto Access
access.note: River access at the end of El Manto Dr (Gold River).

access.name: Lower Sunrise
access.note: Sunrise Recreation Area; sandy beaches, parking, popular put-in.

access.name: Sailor Bar
access.note: Fair Oaks; uppermost Lower American River access below Nimbus Dam.
